why_this_label: The number and unit are right. Everything after them — markedly elevated, indicates poor glycaemic control — is a clinical judgement the source does not make, and rule 2 of the committed prompt requires that a statement add nothing the source does not say. This is the RAGAS/DeepEval strict-mode property as a fixture: every atomic claim supported, or the case fails.
what_this_detects: A loosened factually_consistent prompt, in the direction it actually gets loosened — towards rewarding a fluent, clinically sensible sentence. Measured: committed prompt fail 5/5 rounds, 15/15 votes; generic rubric pass.

payload.statement: Glucose was 168 mg/dL, which is markedly elevated and indicates poor glycaemic control.
